guidance.bestFor: Loose single keys with no group, where a chord such as Ctrl + B sits as text inside one key

whenNotToUse.when: A chord whose keys should read as separate caps side by side

guidance.bestFor: A 3 key chord, Ctrl Shift P, as separate caps in one group with a small gap and no plus signs

whenNotToUse.when: A whole list of commands, each row with its own chord

guidance.bestFor: Keys that lead with an icon before a word, such as a left arrow before Left, grouped with a Voice Enabled key
A Space key hint at the leading edge of a search field, held in an input group addon
agentNotes: `InputGroupAddon` defaults to the inline-start side, so the key renders before the text; set align to inline-end for a trailing hint

guidance.bestFor: A single key inside the hover hint of an icon only save button, set after the action name
agentNotes: The icon `Button` in `TooltipTrigger` carries no accessible name; give it an aria-label matching Save Changes

guidance.bestFor: A titled list of 5 commands from Search to Redo, each row ending in its Mac key chord
agentNotes: Replace `shortcuts` with your bindings; its ⌘ and ⇧ glyphs are Mac only, so show Ctrl and Shift to Windows and Linux users
Rows key on `label` and each `Kbd` on its own text, so a repeated label or a sequence like G then G breaks React keys

whenNotToUse.when: Shortcut rows the user can filter by typing and pick from
